title: anthemis arvensis var. agrestis
intro: Anthemis arvensis var. agrestis, commonly known as Cornflower, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is valued for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and aiding in the relief of anxiety and stress due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Cornflower include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
